title: The Still Traveler
text: In the dark between places a lantern burns. Under it a hooded traveler sits very still, with a pack exactly like yours, down to the patch and the stain. It does not move. Its hood is turned toward you.

options.label: The Leader speaks to it to learn why it carries their pack.

outcomes.text: It is the Leader, a little older. It says one thing, and that one thing is worth the trip.
It is the Leader, a little older, and it is not well.

options.label: Swap packs with it to see what the road has yet to give you.

outcomes.text: Its pack holds things you have not found yet, some of which you do not want to find.

options.label: The Leader puts out its lantern so it watches no longer.

outcomes.text: The lantern goes out, and so does the traveler. The dark is darker now, and you understand it a little better.
